items.html: No eventual-liveness guarantee — no auto-retry, backoff, timeout, or watchdog on a release_failed obligation; the kernel tracks it but does not re-drive it. The retry that turns "tracked" into "eventually discharged" is later → L9

No deferred release boundary realized — the parameterized hook is in (initiate_release(instance, boundary_event), guard boundary_event ∉ release_boundaries(template)), but no post-completion action emits a non-terminal boundary yet; the merge / commit actions that do are → LC3a

No retained / external release policy exercised — the policy vocabulary and load-time rule are in, but the anchor only uses required; a long-lived (retained) or externally-owned (external) runtime_context is a later, explicit ownership choice → later
No workflow actions — the type: action steps that run git commit / merge (and emit a deferred boundary like merge_completed), perf-test, publish, notify → LC3a / LC3b
No archive / export / purge — the record-purge half of v1 delete is a storage-axis op, not resource teardown → LC4
No provider internals — the git worktree / branch / tmux removal mechanics are the provider's, opaque to the kernel, exactly as on the provision side → impl
No remote / distributed release proofs — a remote or async release with verifiable completion (the merge-as-distribution concern) is later → L8 / L10
No child release fan-out — a child is just another runtime_context the same contract releases; L4 multiplies the count, not the contract → L4
